title: Celestin hearing him at Italian Hall; clarinettists in Celestin's band
summary: Celestin hired him after a jam; talk of Baby Ridgely and Celestin's clarinet players Peele, Toomey and Humphrey.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: And when did Celestan pick up on you?

Well Celestan picked up on me one night. I went to Italian Hall on Esplanade Street. Well I wasn't playing that night and I just went there and I wanted to blow something. He had never seen me. And I played a little bit and he asked me who I was working with. I told him well I just wasn't working with nobody at that particular time. So he said well come to the high school. And I went to the high school. And he played a lot of old time stuff. Well I played you know I played the second trumpet right behind him. And he told me, he said get up and blow something and let the boys hear you. And I got up and blow it and especially that tramo player, he's crazy about me. Baby, what's his name, Baby?
I know who you mean. He's an old man now, lives uptown. Yeah, yeah. Up around Calton. On Edinburgh he used to live. Is that the guy Baby Ridgely? Baby Ridgely, yeah.
Baby Ridgely, yeah. And I didn't play with them too long. Was Ridgely?
Was Ridgely a strict reader or did he play by ear too?
Well he read like the devil's lots. Maybe a few pieces he played by ear but he always had that music up there.
Did they have any clarinets or saxophones there?
Yeah, they had good clarinets players.
Who was clarinet with Celestine?
I'm trying to think. The last one I know was this little fella, what we tell me this now. What do you know, the hump in his back? That's the last one I know played with. Not the cripple fella?
Yeah, Peele.
Peele played with fellow Stan?
Yeah. Same time you were.
Yeah. Yeah, Peele was in the band when I got there. Yeah. But he had a better clarinet player than Peele though, but I can't figure who he was, no. He had several of them.
He had Willard Toomey at one time, did you know him?
Yeah, then after I heard he had Willie Humphreys a while.
Yeah, and let me see, there was another one I can't think of. Well, let's see, Paul Barnes I think played clarinet. Yeah.
Carrier. Yeah, way down, he lived way down.
Sidney Carrier, did you know him?
Sidney Carrier, yeah, I know him but I can't, you know, I'm a member, but I know Paul Barnes good.
Yeah. Well, they were all in there around that time, a little later maybe.
Mm-hmm.
